create_parakeet_for_ctc_model: create a ParakeetForCTC model for automatic speech recognition with CTC loss
run_parakeet_encoder_forward: run the ParakeetEncoder forward pass on audio input features to get hidden states
build_parakeet_encoder_with_attention: build a ParakeetEncoder with multi-head attention, relative positional encoding, and convolution modules
test_parakeet_ctc_loss_computation: test the ParakeetForCTC forward pass with labels to compute CTC loss
generate_parakeet_transcription: generate ASR transcription from audio using ParakeetForCTC greedy decoding
